name: Laden Palm
description: Strike with a palm whose qi carries a film of soul force that stings the will as well as the flesh.

name: Layered Veil
description: Wrap the body in qi and wrap the qi in soul force so a blow must pass both layers.

name: Twin Reading
description: Read a foe's qi and soul at once and note where the one is stronger than the other.

name: Imprint Blow
description: Press the soul into the qi of a blow so it leaves a mark on both flesh and will.

name: Marked Qi
description: Mark the target's circulating qi with soul force so each pulse of it cramps their focus.

name: Double Layer
description: Hold qi and soul in two matched layers so each strengthens the other as the fight goes on.

name: Wounding Qi
description: Drive qi shot through with soul force into the target so the wound opens in body and will together.

name: Imprint Sweep
description: Sweep a wide arc of laden qi that bruises the flesh and the will of every foe it crosses.

name: Dual Wound
description: Open the body and the soul with one stroke so the harm lands past every guard on both.

name: Imprint Strike
description: streams: Weapon Soul + Qi; fuse them in the blow so one stroke wounds body and will as a single harm.

name: Weighted Soul
description: Let the soul settle into the limbs until each blow carries the heft of the body.

name: Presence Strike
description: Strike with a fist that carries soul weight so the target feels the blow in the will first.

name: Heavy Ward
description: Set the body square and let the soul's weight root it so a pushing blow cannot move it.

name: Body Echo
description: Feel the soul's echo in the body and read the same echo in another to judge their strength.

name: Pressing Presence
description: Stand over a foe with the full weight of body and soul until they falter beneath it.

name: Twofold Blow
description: Land a blow that strikes the flesh and the will at once with the same fall of weight.

name: Flesh Anchor
description: Anchor the target's soul to the weight of their own body so they cannot lift either.

name: Heavy Hush
description: Drop a heavy stillness over the target's focus so their next breath and their next thought both stall.

name: Soul Fist
description: Drive a fist wrapped in soul weight into the target and break the guard of body and will together.

name: Presence Crush
description: Bear down with the whole bodily weight of the soul until the target can no longer stand.

name: Embodied Wound
description: Strike as one being of flesh and soul and wound the target's soul past every barrier.

name: Embodied Blow
description: streams: Weapon Soul + Body; make the soul's strike a bodily one so flesh and will break under it together.

name: Arc Prick
description: Prick the target's will with a small bright arc that jumps from the user's hand.

name: Charged Veil
description: Wear a crackling veil of charge over the soul that scatters a probing touch.

name: Spark Read
description: Throw a spark at a soul and read the speed of its answer to judge how quick it is.

name: Jolt Snap
description: Snap a sudden jolt through the target's will so their technique jerks and breaks off.

name: Quick Thread
description: Run a thread of charged soul force through a gap in the guard faster than it can close.

name: Impulse Chain
description: Pass one impulse from stroke to stroke so each lands the moment the last has landed.

name: Forked Needle
description: Split a charged needle into forks in flight so one point finds the gap if the others miss.

name: Bright Cascade
description: Let a bright cascade of charged soul force pour over every foe in front of the user.

name: Instant Wound
description: Strike with the speed of the flash so that the wound reaches the soul before any guard can rise.

name: Impulse Spear
description: streams: Weapon Soul + Thunder; send the soul along the flash as one spear that arrives with its own light.
